_about: The numbered parts on a chapter's specimen drawing, keyed by chapter id (the owner's decision of 25 Oct 2026: Lithography only for now; add a chapter only from a sourced list). Each part has its number (n), its name, and either its maker as the chapter's card and text source it (maker) or the chapter that covers it (stage, a chapter id, shown as 'see stage NN, Title'). 'at' lists the points on the specimen its balloon points at, in the specimen's own units as specimens/<specimen>.js draws them; the runtime turns them with the drawing (src/app.js Stage.balloons). build/build.js draws the list under the specimen's caption. 'still' is the drawing the readable page dist/<chapter>/ shows in place of the live one (build/assets/specimens/, the hybrid mockup's annotated render): its file, its size in pixels, and each part's points on it, in the order of 'parts'.
